question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/call of search_cloudflare_documentation with the query 'how does Workers billing work', sent alone with MCP-Protocol-Version 2025-06-18, no session id and no prior handshake on the connection

decoded.result: a JSON-RPC result on the event stream carrying documentation chunks, each with its source URL, title and text: the first is https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/unified-billing/ ('Unified Billing'), returned as semantically similar chunks the tool's own schema describes
decoded.no-challenge: no www-authenticate header and no refusal of any kind; the call was answered on its merits
decoded.session: no session id was issued at initialize and none was sent with this call; the server answered a bare tools/call anyway
decoded.not-measured: the second tool, migrate_pages_to_workers_guide, was not called, and no account-scoped Cloudflare server was re-measured today

finding: Cloudflare's Documentation MCP server answers a keyless tools/call with real documentation: search_cloudflare_documentation returned source-attributed chunks from developers.cloudflare.com to a caller with no credentials, no account and no session. The 2026-09-18 probe of this surface ended by saying that nothing in it measured what a tool call returns; this is that measurement, and it is what the entry's noAccountNeeded cell now rests on rather than a handshake and a tools/list. The server identified itself as docs-ai-search 0.4.13 at initialize in the same run, the same version as on 09-18 and 09-12.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -m 25 -X POST https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search_cloudflare_documentation","arguments":{"query":"how does Workers billing work"}}}'
